extracted.intended_audience: radio, television and digital news organizations (and producers) preparing submissions for the Edward R. Murrow Awards
extracted.subtask_description: Rules and evaluative submission criteria for entering the RTDNA Edward R. Murrow Awards across radio, television and digital divisions, including division/market classification, partnership rules, and per-category submission requirements (time limits, editing, formats, documentation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Proper division and region submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Entries must be submitted in the proper division and region to be considered for judging. Entrants that do not enter correctly will be disqualified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Market size is determined by MSA ranking for radio entries and by DMA ranking for television entries. RTDNA reserves the sole right to reclassify the submission without prior notice to the entrant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Division: Large Market Station
rubrics_metrics.description: Large Market Station: Markets 1 - 50
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use MSA/DMA ranking to determine eligibility for radio/TV large market divisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Division: Small Market Station
rubrics_metrics.description: Small Market Station: Markets 51+
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stations in markets ranked 51 and higher enter the small market division.

rubrics_metrics.name: Division: Network, Syndication Service, Program Service
rubrics_metrics.description: Any organization that programs to multiple markets
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entities programming across multiple markets should enter in this division rather than single-market divisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Division: Digital News Organizations (definition)
rubrics_metrics.description: "Pure Play" digital organizations; no portion of digital entries should have been broadcast
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Digital News Organizations must be primarily online news outlets that do not feature broadcast material; entrants are required to provide verification of monthly unique visitors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Division: Small Digital News Organization
rubrics_metrics.description: 2,499,999 or fewer unique visitors per month
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entrants must provide verification of Monthly Unique Visitors; failure to send verification may result in RTDNA reclassifying the submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Division: Large Digital News Organization
rubrics_metrics.description: 2,500,000 or more unique visitors per month
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entrants must provide verification of Monthly Unique Visitors; both Small and Large Digital entries will be judged only at the national level.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verification of digital size requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Digital News Organization entrants are required to send verification of Monthly Unique Visitors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If no verification is sent, RTDNA reserves the sole right to reclassify the submission without prior notice to the entrant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judging level for digital divisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Both Small and Large Digital entries will be judged only at the national level.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Digital division size affects only classification; awards are judged nationally rather than by region/market.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partnership submission rule
rubrics_metrics.description: Any entry produced in a partnership must be submitted in the market and region of the largest partner.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A “partner” is defined as someone who provides production assistance or significant editorial input for an entry. If an organization is only helping distribute work to a wider audience, they will not be considered a partner. All partner organizations must be listed on the award entry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dual licensee rule
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter video content into TV categories, audio content into Radio categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organizations holding both licenses should submit each piece into the category matching the content format (audio vs video).

rubrics_metrics.name: State-wide networks & regional collaborations rule
rubrics_metrics.description: State-wide networks should submit in the largest market size in their state. Regional collaborations should submit in the market size and region of the largest partner.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the largest partner's market/region for classification of collaborative entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Terrestrial, satellite & digital classification
rubrics_metrics.description: A terrestrial station that is also broadcast via satellite and/or online counts as a radio station in the appropriate market size. A purely satellite station should apply in the “Network” radio category. A purely digital radio station without a terrestrial station should enter in the digital category.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classify by the station's principal distribution method; mixed-distribution terrestrial outlets remain in broadcast categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: General editing and commercial-break removal rule
rubrics_metrics.description: Many categories allow editing but require that all commercial breaks must be removed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where editing is permitted, the entry may be edited but all commercial breaks must be removed. Some categories specify additional editing restrictions (e.g., no editing allowed in certain digital Innovation category entries).

rubrics_metrics.name: Voice-over / narrative permission
rubrics_metrics.description: Voice-overs or narratives are permitted only if they were part of the original piece.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For categories that allow voice-overs/narration, entrants cannot add new voice-over or narrative elements that were not present in the originally aired/posted piece.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category: Excellence in Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (scope)
rubrics_metrics.description: Honors outstanding journalism tackling the topic of diversity, racial injustice and/or inequality. The storytelling must bring an awareness to an issue(s) and potentially bring about a solution or dialogue.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Piece can be digital, video, audio, or all three; can be single piece or series; 30-minute time limit; entry may be edited and all commercial breaks must be removed; voice-overs/narratives only if in original; a short description of the entry is requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category: Podcast (definition & requirements)
rubrics_metrics.description: Podcasts are defined as digital audio files made available on the internet for downloading to a computer or mobile device, typically available as a series.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entry must demonstrate original and outstanding journalistic enterprise on an important issue; may feature a single episode or an edited overview of a series; entry may be edited and all commercial breaks must be removed; voice-overs/narratives permitted only if part of original; short description requested; entry must not exceed 30 minutes; entrants should also provide an active link to the full podcast series.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category: Newscast (eligibility & editing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Only regularly scheduled newscasts are eligible; only one entry is allowed per station. Networks can submit one entry per news program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commercial breaks must be removed but no other editing is allowed. Voice-overs/narratives only if part of the original piece. Entry must not exceed 30 minutes; if program is longer, submit only the first 30 minutes. Short description requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category: Breaking News Coverage (time & scope)
rubrics_metrics.description: Entry should only contain coverage from first 24 hours after the news event. Submit coverage of a single, unscheduled news event.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entry may be edited and all commercial breaks must be removed. Voice-overs/narratives permitted only if they were part of the original piece. Entry must not exceed 20 minutes. A short description is requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category: Investigative Reporting (evidence & time limit)
rubrics_metrics.description: Entry must demonstrate original and outstanding journalistic enterprise on an important issue. Entry may include undercover sources, extensive research of documents and records, and include records and documentation of allegations made in the report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entry may be edited and all commercial breaks must be removed. Voice-overs/narratives only if part of original. A short description is requested. Entry must not exceed 15 minutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category: Hard News (scope and exclusions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit a single hard news report prepared for a scheduled newscast that is not breaking news and not primarily investigative in nature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Humorous or soft-topic stories do not belong in this category. Report must have appeared on a regularly scheduled news program. Entry may not be entered in the Feature Reporting category. Entry may be edited. Voice-overs/narratives only if part of the original. Short description requested. Entry must not exceed 10 minutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category: Continuing Coverage (requirements)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit an entry showing continuing coverage of a major developing story over an extended period of time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entry may be edited (commercial breaks removed). Voice-overs/narratives permitted only if part of original. The entry should include at least one complete news report. Entry must not exceed 30 minutes. Short description requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category: News Series
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit coverage of a single subject reported in multiple parts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entry may be edited. Voice-overs/narratives only if part of original. A short description is requested. Entry must not exceed 30 minutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category: Feature Reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit a single report covering a human-interest or profile subject that is not breaking news or investigative in nature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report must have appeared on a regularly scheduled news program. Entry may not be entered in the Hard News category. Entry may be edited. Voice-overs/narratives permitted only if part of original. A short description of the entry is requested. Entry must not exceed 10 minutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category: Sports Reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit a single packaged report reflecting a journalistic endeavor to report on a newsworthy sports-related subject.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Anchored sports segments within programs, stand-alone sports programs and play-by-play are not eligible. Entry must be unedited. A short description of the entry is requested. Entry must not exceed 10 minutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category: Excellence in Sound (radio & digital)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit coverage of a single subject reported in a single segment showing creative use of sound to tell a story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open to both radio and digital news organizations. Entry must be exactly as it was heard on the air or online. 'Year-ender' packages are not allowed. Entry must not exceed 10 minutes. A short description of the entry is requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category: Excellence in Video (television & digital)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit coverage of a single subject reported in a single segment showing creative use of video to tell a story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open to television and digital entrants. Entry must be exactly as it appeared on air or online. 'Year-ender' packages are not allowed. Entry must not exceed 10 minutes. A short description of the entry is requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category: News Documentary (length & focus)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit coverage of a single subject reported in a single segment addressing a need or needs of your market.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entry may be edited. Voice-overs/narratives permitted only if part of original. Entry must not exceed 60 minutes. A short description is requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category: Feature-Length Documentary (network TV only)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit coverage of a single subject reported in a single segment addressing a need or needs of your audience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entry may be edited. Voice-overs/narratives permitted only if part of original. Entry must be more than 60 minutes in length. A short description is requested. This category is for Network Television only.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category: Excellence in Writing (scripts required)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit an entry that demonstrates excellence in writing that conveys the feeling and significance of events to the listener or viewer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entry may represent an individual or collaborative effort and may include up to three examples, exactly as it originally appeared. A script of each example must accompany the entry. A short description is requested. Entry must not exceed 15 minutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category: Excellence in Innovation (legacy broadcast)
rubrics_metrics.description: Designed to award legacy radio or television news organizations that innovate their product to enhance the quality of journalism and the audience’s understanding of news.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit a single entry that demonstrates an innovative use of content, engagement, technology and/or audience experience. A single entry may include audio or video examples; functioning, cached or active URLs; apps; social feeds; or any other platform that demonstrates innovation in journalism. Audio or video entries must not exceed 30 minutes (if original longer, submit only first 30 minutes). Commercial breaks must be removed but no other editing is allowed. A written description explaining how the entry breaks the mold of traditional broadcast journalism is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category: Digital (site & multimedia requirements)
rubrics_metrics.description: This category allows stations to showcase their website and/or multimedia (broadcast, digital and social media) approach to stories. The news organization's online presence, as its principal function, must disseminate timely news and information targeted for its core audiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: News content must be generated primarily by entrant, supplemented by secondary content from wire services or networks. The site should be of practical use to the general public and maximize online technologies to inform and educate. Submit up to 5 examples of functioning, cached or active URLs that demonstrate exceptional news coverage and journalistic skill (note: 'up to 5' is a stated change). If the entry includes audio or video content, total run time may not exceed 30 minutes. Entry must include original content. Creativity, clarity, storytelling techniques, and use of audio, video or other Internet technologies will be considered. A short description is requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital Category: News Series (URLs & time limit)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit up to five functioning, cached or active URLs linking to coverage of a single subject reported in multiple parts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A short description of the entry is requested. If the entry includes audio or video content, total run time may not exceed 30 minutes. Entry may be edited.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital Category: Podcast (digital-specific reiteration)
rubrics_metrics.description: Same podcast definition and expectations apply: must demonstrate original and outstanding journalistic enterprise on an important issue.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entry may feature a single episode or an edited overview of a series; entry may be edited and commercials removed; voice-overs/narratives only if part of original; short description requested; entry must not exceed 30 minutes; provide active link to the full podcast series.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital Category: Breaking News Coverage (URLs & time)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit up to five functioning, cached or active URLs linking to coverage of the single, unscheduled news event covering the first 24 hours after the event.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A short description is requested. If includes audio/video, total run time may not exceed 20 minutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital Category: Investigative Reporting (URLs & evidence)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit up to five functioning, cached or active URLs linking to an entry which must demonstrate original and outstanding journalistic enterprise on an important issue.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entry may include undercover material, document research, records documenting allegations. Short description requested. If includes audio/video, total run time may not exceed 15 minutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital Category: Hard News (URL & exclusion)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit a functioning, cached or active URL linking to an entry which consists of a single hard news report that is not breaking news and not primarily investigative in nature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Humorous or soft-topic stories do not belong in this category. Entry may not be entered in Feature Reporting category. Short description requested. If includes audio/video, total run time may not exceed 10 minutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital Category: Continuing Coverage (URLs & content)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit up to five functioning, cached or active URLs linking to coverage showing continuing coverage of a major developing story over an extended period of time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The entry should include at least one complete news report. Short description requested. If includes audio/video, total run time may not exceed 30 minutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital Category: Feature Reporting (URL & limit)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit a functioning, cached or active URL linking to a single report covering a human-interest or profile subject not breaking or investigative in nature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entry may not be entered in Hard News. Short description requested. If includes audio/video, total run time may not exceed 10 minutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital Category: Sports Reporting (URL & unedited rule)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit a single packaged report reflecting a journalistic endeavor to report on a newsworthy sports-related subject.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Anchored sports segments, stand-alone sports programs, and play-by-play are not eligible. Entry must be unedited. Short description requested. Entry must not exceed 10 minutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital Category: Excellence in Sound (digital specifics)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit a functioning, cached or active URL linking to a single subject reported in a single segment showing creative use of sound to tell a story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entry must be exactly as it was heard on a digital platform or platforms. 'Year-ender' packages are not allowed. Short description requested. Total run time may not exceed 10 minutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital Category: Excellence in Video (digital specifics)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit a functioning, cached or active URL linking to a single subject reported in a single segment showing creative use of video to tell a story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entry must be exactly as it appeared on a digital platform or platforms. 'Year-ender' packages are not allowed. Short description requested. Total run time may not exceed 10 minutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital Category: News Documentary (URL & run time)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit a functioning, cached or active URL linking to a single subject reported in a single segment addressing a need or needs of your users.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entry may be edited. Short description requested. If includes audio/video, total run time may not exceed 60 minutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital Category: Excellence in Writing (URL & examples)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit a functioning, cached or active URL to an entry demonstrating excellence in writing that conveys the feeling and significance of events to the user.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entry may represent an individual or collaborative effort and may include up to three examples, exactly as it originally appeared. Short description requested. If includes audio/video, total run time may not exceed 15 minutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital Category: Excellence in Innovation (digital edition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Designed to award digital news organizations that innovate their product to enhance the quality of journalism and the audience’s understanding of news.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit a functioning, cached or active URL linking to a single entry that demonstrates innovative use of content, engagement, technology and/or audience experience. A single entry may include audio or video examples; apps; social feeds; or other platforms. Audio/video entries must not exceed 30 minutes (if original longer, submit only first 30 minutes). No editing is allowed. A written description explaining how the entry breaks the mold of traditional journalism is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall Excellence (TV & Radio eligibility)
rubrics_metrics.description: To be eligible to compete in this category, TV and Radio Stations must enter at least two other categories including: Breaking News, Hard News, Investigative Reporting, Continuing Coverage, or Newscast.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit a single entry that contains examples of breaking news, continuing coverage, features and/or other work, including your web presence that reflects the depth and scope of the news organization. Judging will be based on the original work samples and not on the way the entry is produced. Entry must include examples of a robust Web and digital media presence; relevant links may be inserted in the text box provided, or attached in a .pdf and uploaded to the entry form. Entrants are limited to 5 links for digital examples in addition to the 40-minutes of audio or video content for the entry. Entry may be edited (all commercials removed). Voice-overs/narratives permitted only if part of original. Entry must not exceed 40 minutes. A written rundown is required for audio and video.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall Excellence (Digital eligibility & submission limits)
rubrics_metrics.description: To be eligible, Digital News Organizations must enter at least two other categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit an entry that contains up to ten live or cached URLs linking to examples of breaking news, continuing coverage, features and/or other work that reflects the depth and scope of the news organization. Apps and social feeds may also be submitted as part of the ten examples. Judging will be based on the original work samples and not on the way the entry is produced. If the entry includes audio or video content, total run time may not exceed 40 minutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: URL/submission quantity limits (digital examples)
rubrics_metrics.description: Digital entries specify how many functioning/cached/active URLs may be submitted per category (commonly up to five; Overall Excellence allows up to ten).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the stated per-category URL limits: many categories allow up to five URLs; Overall Excellence (Digital) allows up to ten URLs; TV/Radio Digital examples in Overall Excellence are limited to 5 links in addition to audio/video content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judging based on original work samples
rubrics_metrics.description: Judging will be based on the original work samples and not on the way the entry is produced.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide original aired/published material or functioning cached URLs; judges evaluate the journalism itself rather than the packaging of the entry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Short description requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Many categories request a short description of the entry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a concise description explaining the entry's subject, scope, and relevance; often required alongside uploaded media/URLs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entry run-time caps per category
rubrics_metrics.description: Each category specifies a maximum run time for audio/video content (e.g., 10, 15, 20, 30, 40, 60 minutes depending on category).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the original piece exceeds the category limit, submit only the allowed portion (explicitly specified in some categories). Adhere strictly to time limits per category to maintain eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: No 'year-ender' packages for certain categories
rubrics_metrics.description: 'Year-ender' packages are not allowed in Excellence in Sound, Excellence in Video, and equivalent digital categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not submit end-of-year compilation packages in these creative/technical categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Original content requirement for digital entries
rubrics_metrics.description: The news organization's online presence, as its principal function, must disseminate timely news and information; news content must be generated primarily by entrant, supplemented by secondary content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries should demonstrate original reporting and content creation by the entrant rather than primarily aggregated wire content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentation requirement for Excellence in Writing
rubrics_metrics.description: A script of each example must accompany the Excellence in Writing entry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When submitting writing examples (up to three), include the exact scripts as originally published/aired to allow judges to assess craft and writing quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Innovation category written explanation
rubrics_metrics.description: A written description explaining how the entry breaks the mold of traditional journalism is required for Innovation categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide clear explanation of how content, engagement, technology or audience experience is innovative and enhances journalism; required for both broadcast and digital Innovation categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: No editing allowed (certain digital Innovation)
rubrics_metrics.description: For the Digital Excellence in Innovation category, 'No editing is allowed.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If submitting audio/video as part of a digital Innovation entry, do not alter the original posted content; submit only original material (and, if longer than 30 minutes, only the first 30 minutes).

rubrics_metrics.name: Entrant listing requirement for partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: All partner organizations must be listed on the award entry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose all organizations that provided production assistance or significant editorial input to avoid classification/eligibility issues.
